technology_name: A VOICE ALERT AGRICULTURAL MONITORING SYSTEM FOR ALERTING USERS OF AGRICULTURAL PARAMETERS AND METHOD THEREOF
institution: National Institute of Technology Calicut (NIT Calicut)
technology_type: Smart Agriculture System / Voice Telemetry Matrix
problem_solved: Legacy agricultural telemetry nodes output raw, non-intuitive database logs on obscure smartphone tracking dashboards, leaving non-technical farmers unaware of sudden crop stressors.
description: An autonomous smart farming telemetry module combining an array of local soil moisture/temperature sensors, a real-time rain gauge, an automated parsing script, and a micro-speaker speech generation unit to transmit local alerts in native languages.
applications: Smart precision farming networks, automated irrigation management boxes, smallholder farm optimization tools, and agricultural extension accessibility hardware.
secondary_sector: Robotics, Automation & Drones, Agribusiness & Rural Economy
